# UUID & ID Generator

> Generate UUID v4, UUID v7, ULID and Nano ID instantly. One-click copy — no tracking, no dependencies.
> Source: https://github.com/davlgd/uuidgen

All identifiers are generated server-side using cryptographically secure randomness (`crypto.randomUUID`, `Bun.randomUUIDv7`, `crypto.getRandomValues`). No data is stored or logged. No tracking.

## Supported formats

- **UUID v4**: 128-bit identifier from 122 bits of cryptographic randomness (RFC 9562)
- **UUID v7**: Timestamp-prefixed UUID, lexicographically sortable by creation time (RFC 9562)
- **ULID**: Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier, 26-char Crockford Base32
- **Nano ID**: Compact 21-char URL-safe identifier, 126 bits of entropy

## API

- `GET /` with `Accept: application/json` or `Accept: text/yaml` returns all four identifiers at once (`uuidv4`, `uuidv7`, `ulid`, `nanoid`).
- `GET /:type` returns one identifier of the given type. Valid types: `uuidv4`, `uuidv7`, `ulid`, `nanoid`.
